verdict.rationale: Privacy and data-handling posture is a fair question for a security scanning tool, especially one that ships an MCP plugin for AI tools, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of any AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy, or guarantee that scanned data is excluded from model training. The MCP plugin evidence only describes natural-language scanning, not data-use controls, and the supply-chain compromise reports are unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
